title: Oleanolic acid cubic liquid crystal nanoparticle-based thermosensitive gel attenuates knee osteoarthritis symptoms in rats.
authors: Shi, Zhiqi; Jia, Fan; Tang, Xiaoyu; Li, Qing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究齐墩果酸液晶纳米凝胶治疗大鼠膝骨关节炎的药效与机制，属纯药物递送与疾病模型研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Knee osteoarthritis (KOA) is a prevalent degenerative joint disease with limited effective treatment options. Oleanolic acid (OA) possesses promising anti-inflammatory and cartilage-protective properties, but its clinical application is hindered by poor solubility and rapid metabolism. PURPOSE: This study aimed to develop an oleanolic acid-loaded liquid crystalline nanogel (OANG) for intra-articular delivery and to systematically evaluate its therapeutic effects and potential mechanisms in a rat KOA model. METHODS: OA-loaded nanoparticles were prepared and incorporated into a thermosensitive Poloxamer gel base to form OANG. A papain-induced KOA rat model was established. Rats were administered OANG (high/low dose) intra-articularly, with celecoxib as a positive control. Evaluations included behavioral tests, micro-computed tomography, histological analyses (hematoxylin and eosin, transmission electron microscopy, immunohistochemistry), enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay of synovial fluid, serum, and hippocampus, Western blot (WB), network pharmacology, and molecular docking. RESULTS: OANG exhibited sustained-release properties and improved joint lubrication. Treatment with OANG significantly alleviated KOA-induced pain and depression-like behaviors, reduced cartilage degradation and subchondral bone sclerosis, and downregulated levels of pro-inflammatory cytokines (tumor necrosis factor-alpha, interleukin-1beta, interleukin-6) and cartilage degradation markers (C-terminal cross-linked telopeptide of type II collagen, cartilage oligomeric matrix protein) in synovial fluid. It also enhanced antioxidant capacity (increased superoxide dismutase, glutathione peroxidase; decreased malondialdehyde) and modulated the expression of key cartilage proteins (increased Collagen II; decreased matrix metalloproteinase 13; regulated glycogen synthase kinase-3beta/SRY-box transcription factor 9, beta-catenin, and Yes-associated protein). Furthermore, OANG ameliorated hippocampal oxidative stress and inflammation (decreased Cleaved caspase-3, Malondialdehyde; increased IL-10). Network pharmacology and docking suggested the involvement of peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma, mitogen-activated protein kinase 3, prostaglandin-endoperoxide synthase 2, and pathways such as estrogen signaling and cyclic adenosine monophosphate signaling.
abstract_zh: 背景：膝骨关节炎（KOA）是一种常见的退行性关节疾病，有效治疗选择有限。齐墩果酸（OA）具有前景的抗炎和软骨保护特性，但其临床应用受限于溶解性差和快速代谢。目的：本研究旨在开发一种负载齐墩果酸的液晶纳米凝胶（OANG），用于关节腔内递送，并系统评估其在大鼠KOA模型中的治疗效果及潜在机制。方法：制备负载OA的纳米颗粒，并将其掺入热敏性泊洛沙姆凝胶基质中形成OANG。建立木瓜蛋白酶诱导的KOA大鼠模型。大鼠关节腔内给予OANG（高/低剂量），以塞来昔布作为阳性对照。评估包括行为测试、微型计算机断层扫描、组织学分析（苏木精和伊红染色、透射电子显微镜、免疫组织化学）、滑液、血清和海马的酶联免疫吸附测定、蛋白质印迹（WB）、网络药理学和分子对接。结果：OANG表现出缓释特性并改善关节润滑。OANG治疗显著缓解了KOA诱导的疼痛和抑郁样行为，减少了软骨降解和软骨下骨硬化，并下调了滑液中促炎细胞因子（肿瘤坏死因子-α、白细胞介素-1β、白细胞介素-6）和软骨降解标志物（II型胶原C端交联端肽、软骨寡聚基质蛋白）的水平。它还增强了抗氧化能力（增加超氧化物歧化酶、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶；降低丙二醛）并调节关键软骨蛋白的表达（增加II型胶原；降低基质金属蛋白酶13；调节糖原合成酶激酶-3β/SRY相关HMG盒转录因子9、β-连环蛋白和Yes相关蛋白）。此外，OANG改善了海马氧化应激和炎症（降低Cleaved caspase-3、丙二醛；增加IL-10）。网络药理学和对接提示过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ、丝裂原活化蛋白激酶3、前列腺素内过氧化物合酶2以及雌激素信号和环磷酸腺苷信号等通路的参与。
